New listing (posted November 27, 2026)

35th Hannoki Award nomination period. Hanno City's Neighborhood Association Federation presents the Hannoki Award to citizens and organizations who have been steadily engaged in practical community activities to build a bright, livable local society.

Eligible activities: Activities that deepen human connection and understanding, activities that nurture healthy mind and body, activities that build a pleasant hometown.

Who can be nominated: Individuals, organizations, groups, and community associations active in the city.

How to nominate: Fill out the required nomination form with all necessary information and submit it. Nominators will be interviewed by phone or other means and will be asked to attend the selection meeting.

Where to submit: Hanno City Neighborhood Association Federation Secretariat (Jichi Shinko Division, 1st floor of the Annex Building, Hanno City Hall), 1-1 Oaza Futayanagi, Hanno City, Saitama 357-8501. Phone: 042-973-2111 (ext. 6401). Email: jiti@city.hanno.lg.jp. Or submit to any district administrative center.

Submission period: Friday, December 4, 2026 through Wednesday, January 6, 2027.

Selection schedule: Interviews (ongoing after nomination forms are received), Selection Committee meeting Wednesday, February 17, 2027, Annex Building, Hanno City Hall.

Important: Religious activities, activities that are part of profit-making ventures, activities performed as job duties, and activities undertaken as a member of an organization are not eligible.

Source (Japanese): https://www.city.hanno.lg.jp/soshikikarasagasu/shiminseikatsubu/jitishinkoka/shiminkatudo/8625.html
